scope: Investigation and procedure index of the Radiology Assistant medical articles in source-catalog.json. Related source articles are grouped only when they support the same examination or clinical reference; source_titles preserve the catalogue titles and source article bodies remain externally attributed. Administrative, application and media-authoring pages are excluded.
